messages:
emma: Heads-up: customer-app reports rerank results differ when using our Python SDK vs calling the rerank API directly. They say ordering flips and scores look like strings in their DB. https://app.customer.example/issue/422 :eyes:
customer-app: repro steps: use py-sdk 0.9.2, send rerank payload with candidates, we get scores as e.g. "0.842" in webhook, and client sorts wrong because it treats them as strings. minimal repro attached below.
liam: Can you paste the exact request body the SDK is sending vs curl?
customer-app: sure — from SDK logs (redacted):
```
{"query": "Which doc is latest?", "candidates": ["A", "B"], "scores": ["0.842", "0.731"]}
```
And when we call curl against /v1/rerank with identical-looking JSON we get:
```
{"query":"Which doc is latest?","candidates":["A","B"],"scores":[0.842,0.731]}
```
emma: Interesting — SDK serializing numbers as strings. Which client language?
customer-app: Python first, but they also tried TS and saw inconsistent parsers depending on how they read the response.
ivan: Could be Decimal or numpy float getting serialized by simplejson or a custom encoder in the SDK. Any snippet of the SDK call?
customer-app: They use our helper:
```
from redwood import RerankClient
client = RerankClient(api_key=...)
client.rerank(query, candidates, scores=[Decimal('0.842'), Decimal('0.731')])
```
liam: If they're passing Decimal objects and our SDK json.dumps has a default=str, that'll emit strings. Should convert Decimal -> float before encoding.
jess: Also saw a bug in TS wrapper where we accidentally stringify scores array in fetch options: `body: JSON.stringify({..., scores: scores.toString()})` in an older branch — that would definitely create a single comma-separated string.
ivan: Repro locally with py-sdk 0.9.2: pass Decimal -> server receives quoted numbers. Verified. We should add a guard in the client to coerce numeric sequences to plain floats or ints.
emma: For the short-term, ask customer to map Decimal to float before calling. For long-term, we need a patch and release. Can you draft repro steps and a quick patch?
ivan: Drafted fix: in client serialize(), walk list/tuple and do `if isinstance(x, Decimal): x = float(x)` and similarly coerce numpy types. Added unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/348 (draft).
liam: Also add a server-side acceptance check: if scores are strings that parse to numbers, coerce before sorting and log a warning with request id. That avoids customer break until clients upgrade.
ess: deploy-bot: Staging build for py-sdk with fix is available: +py-sdk-0.9.3-rc1.
customer-app: Trying with manual float conversion works for us, ordering fixed. Thanks.
emma: Good. Action items: (1) ivan follow up PR to convert Decimal/numpy -> float + tests (2) liam make server fallback to coerce numeric strings and emit warning metric (3) docs note about acceptable score types and limits (0..1 floats). (4) Support send customer remediation steps and timeline for SDK patch release.
jess: I'll own the TS check and patch the fetch body bug, add test where scores = [0.1, 0.9] and ensure JSON body contains numeric array.
customer-app: one more quirk — when scores are strings we also saw slightly higher API latency (~40ms) in our traces. Might be JSON parsing or a validation path on server.
ivan: We'll profile server parsing path; might be extra validation converting strings -> decimals. If so, coercion will remove the extra cost.
emma: Thanks all — I'll update the ticket and mark as escalated. customer-app, we'll follow up with ETA for py-sdk 0.9.3 and TS patch. :thumbsup:
